# Spin the Wheel — Free Online Random Picker & Decision Maker
> Spin the Wheel (https://spinthewheel.buzz) is a fast, 100% free, browser-based wheel spinner and random decision maker. It requires no login, features zero ads/popups, and uses cryptographically secure random number generation.

## Summary & Core Value
Spin the Wheel solves decision fatigue and provides fair, unbiased randomness for classrooms, online giveaways, family game nights, team meetings, and everyday choices (like "What to eat" or "Yes or No").

- **Primary URL**: https://spinthewheel.buzz/
- **Pricing**: 100% Free forever, no sign-up or software installation required.
- **Fairness & Algorithm**: Powered by the browser's cryptographic `crypto.getRandomValues()` API to ensure strictly uniform probability distributions across all slices.

## Key Features
- **Customizable Wheel Segments**: Add, edit, remove, and color-code unlimited wheel choices.
- **Winner Elimination Mode**: Option to automatically remove chosen options after each spin to prevent duplicate selections.
- **Sound Effects & Confetti**: Interactive audio effects and celebratory animations.
- **Shareable Links**: Export custom wheel setups into shareable direct URLs.
- **Mobile & Classroom Ready**: Fully responsive design supporting touch gestures on iOS, Android, tablets, and interactive smartboards.
